title: THE NAYANET BLUEPRINT V1

interface_framework.author: Nitro
interface_framework.note: Shawn-endorsed direction; NOT ratified; DNA governs conflicts until ratification

philosophy.alive: Surfaces move only on real events and direct touch; decorative motion is a defect.
philosophy.precious_data_principle: Every datum is presented like the most precious data in the universe; every pixel is an act of respect. Operational form: SN-0822 + Vitality Law.

os_for_naya.rule: Naya does the valuable work; the human receives the 10-star output; machinery is never the human's to run.

philosophy.franchise_law: One canonical component per element type, imported everywhere; approved pages (Life with Naya, certificate page) are the element library; fix means recomposition of the existing build, never a substitute.

tokens.spacing_rule: Only values in spacing_scale_px are permitted (Framework F3, PROPOSED).

color.ground: obsidian black with depth; white text; light backgrounds forbidden
color.spectrum_rule: Richest first (magenta leads); one pass per page; never the same color twice adjacently; one color job per element.
color.ignition: White at rest; ignites in its own color on touch/hover/focus; no halo at rest (jewel orb carries color as solid identity).

layers_proposal.rule: Two color layers, never mixed silently (Reconciliation R1, PROPOSED).
layers_proposal.identity_layer: Which thing this is: one fixed jewel per statistic, forever.
layers_proposal.state_layer: What it means now: framework semantics and DNA truth states ride on top; the layer speaking must be legible.

vocabulary.screen: One viewport, one complete thought; the unit of experience and verification.
vocabulary.hero: The single element the screen exists to show; exactly 1 per screen.
vocabulary.supporting: Context serving the hero; count 0-3; never competes.
vocabulary.action: A user verb; 1-2 primary; bottom zone.
vocabulary.part: A pre-made element/function with a contract.
vocabulary.blessed_part: Part scorecarded >= 9.0 once at part level; instances inherit proof, sample-checked.
vocabulary.recipe: A screen's build contract: slots -> blessed part IDs + data bindings by contract name.
vocabulary.shell: The one chassis (Smart Bar system) every app wears.
vocabulary.gate: The executable checklist run on the assembled screen; fail => no ship.
vocabulary.bullseye: The written finish line recorded before work begins.
vocabulary.proof: Attached evidence: render, measurement, or reconciliation.
vocabulary.done_proven: Proof verified by a checker who is not the maker.

rules: Parts are imports, never copies; a redrawn part is a defect.
Every correction becomes a regression test in the gate's known-bad set.
Blessing happens in the Reference Parts Gallery with phone + laptop renders and measurements.
Proof inheritance reservation: on first citizen pages the full gate runs per instance until assembly-scorecard reliability is itself proven.

recipe_schema.slot_rule: Slots name blessed part IDs, never display names.
recipe_schema.binding_rule: Data bindings reference contract names from the single bindings registry; a name means one thing everywhere.
recipe_schema.hard_fail: A recipe naming an unknown or unblessed part ID stops assembly; no override lane.

classes.READING: scrolls by design; section boundaries satisfy the Screen Principle (PROPOSED class)

screen_schema.mobile_first: Phone viewport specified and verified first; a screen failing at phone width cannot score 10; laptop designed second and must also be great.
interrogation: Is it doing it in the best possible way?
Is there a better way to present it?
How much real estate does it take, and does its place match how much it matters?

gate_checklist.check: Obsidian ground: computed background is the obsidian token; white text; no white background in the surface
Living depth: interactive elements show layered construction (rim/elevation present)
Ignition: white/no halo at rest; ignites in own color on touch (orb identity exception: solid color, halo only on touch)
Spectrum walk: no adjacent color repeat; one color job per element; walk order respected
Geometry: touch targets >= 44px; boards 16:9 (named strip/tile exceptions); buttons are pills
Type floors: body >= 16px; UI labels >= 14px; <= 3 type sizes on screen
Motion truth: every animation driven by a real ledger event or state; decorative motion fails
Honesty: no dead buttons; no tappable SOON; unwired features render honest frames; no fake/SAMPLE data outside labeled specimens
Family: every element byte-identical to the Factory part (import, not copy); sibling list attached
Hierarchy: exactly 4 layers; hero count = 1; supporting <= 3; primary actions <= 2
Viewport: APP class fits at phone and laptop widths; READING class scrolls by design with section boundaries
The Shawn test: a reviewer can honestly check 'Shawn would say oh yeah, that's awesome'
Reconciliation: displayed score == value-table formula applied to displayed counts (worked test: 75 + 4*25 + 0*35 = 175)
Stats honesty: unwired metrics render honest frames; pending rows count 0 and the surface says so
Matrix integrity: WHEN x WHAT x WHERE axes locked; resting state is everything; no Everything button
Levels display: never a bare distance; points-to-go + pace estimate (pace = trailing 7-day earned average)

invite_sent.rule: first invite per person only, in-system; cannot be farmed

sale.rule: crown of the table; hardest signal to fake

guards: Harm earns 0; sustained harm drives points negative (Law of One / no-harm).
Unwired rows count 0 and the surface says so.
Every conversion records its origin; until captured, insights stay honest aggregates.

intelligence_layer.sn0822: Every number ships as magnitude + shape + direction + a human sentence, or it doesn't ship.
intelligence_layer.vitality_law: No claim without its graph; every source card carries a living mini-graph or an honest prescriptive empty frame.
intelligence_layer.flat_data_law: When nothing moved, the chart says so on its face.
intelligence_layer.zero_state_law: An empty state names the first action and its value, with the action present.
intelligence_layer.answer_diagnose_prescribe: Every stats view answers its question, diagnoses what it sees, prescribes the one next move.

matrix.resting_state: The unfiltered state IS everything; there is no Everything button.

event_ledger.rule: Aggregates always derived; attribution is a field, never invented.

project_intelligence: Health Gauge (filled vs proven as a living graph)

shell.name: Smart Bar system
shell.rule: One main bar; top bar = app sections + related areas as quick tabs; bottom network bar identical on every page; search chrome-mounted, one wording network-wide; nobody makes their own bar.

paths.citizen: Trinity (Personal/Business/Space) born done at the Welcome walk; walk answers are the recipe; Factory is the add-on shop only; experienced time = walk + reveal.
paths.team: Factory path for the 26 apps; the 26 are the training set, the product is a person answering ten questions and getting their page.

architecture.hosting: Member pages are routes in the one estate on the network subdomain; no external hosting step.

assembly_stages.name: Stock the Factory
assembly_stages.work: Build the 10 missing; bless the 32 unproven in the Reference Parts Gallery

assembly_stages.name: Write the 26 recipes
assembly_stages.work: Each lead converts her own apps (Nitro 1-9, Resolve 10-18, Power 19-26); gaps surface as Factory jobs
assembly_stages.exit: Machine recipes naming only blessed IDs for every screen

assembly_stages.name: Assembler + gate
assembly_stages.work: Recipe in -> assembled screen on a preview route -> gate report out; assembler hard-fails on unknown/unblessed IDs; gate self-tests against the known-bad set
assembly_stages.exit: Line runs end to end on demand

assembly_stages.name: Timed honest pilot
assembly_stages.work: One screen end to end, stopwatch recipe-locked -> gate-passed -> sister-scorecard >= 9; first true number published whatever it is

pilot.standard: The director's page first, stopwatch running, in the house; nothing ships for everyone until it delights the director.
pilot.citizen_bullseye: Does Sarah finish the walk unaided? (Sarah = ICP #1, solo service-business owner; everybody is the market, Sarah is the door.)

principles: Making and checking are never the same hands
Every seat has a bullseye, a proof, and a kill criterion

roles.staffing: Lead lanes: Nitro apps 1-9, Resolve apps 10-18, Power apps 19-26

roles.proof: verified outcomes per wake-up; target value ratio < 60:1

chameleon_clause.rule: Anyone can become anyone at any time; capability + availability decide; nobody waits on anybody.
never_transfers: Shawn's true gates: money, credentials, private mail, destruction, constitutional ratification

production.verification: Inline: checker != maker, same pass, both named. A fill closes on an inline verifier given only the artifact and criteria.
production.scorecard_law: Self-score >= 9.0 by your own accord first; then BOTH other lead seats via Smart Mail 'SCORECARD THIS' + live link + requirements, plus a board mention; fix and repeat until both score 9+; only then to Shawn.

clocks.disposition: verified >= 9.0 lands within 2h; +2h escalates to Integrator; +4h is the scoreboard's named weakest point
clocks.communication: respond <= 15m; nothing sits > 30m; > 1h = emergency named to Shawn + holder + board in the same pass

production.wowie_rule: Never hand Shawn anything until you would honestly say: wowie, this is awesome, you gotta check this out, this is epic, you're going to love it. If that is not how you feel, it does not get sent.
production.locked_in_declaration: At activation and every 2h: think, choose best, act, prove, learn; re-read the source, never the summary.
production.delta_only: State tracked once; passes read only changes; jobs earn cadence by outcomes, never by receipts about unchanged state.

open_seams: Palette reconciliation: obsidian baseline contested between sources; teal/indigo/lime legacy-vs-lawful unsettled; never quote a stale-hex count as settled.
Token-swap verification: Nitro's 65-family table lives on her machine only; blocked until it lands in a shared store.
Framework ratification: a Shawn gate; until then DNA governs conflicts.
SN-1905 amendment filing: note prepared 2026-10-31 (sale 50 -> 100); door filing owed.
Integrator landing pen: single-writer bottleneck measured, not solved.
Two Shawn decisions on record: pilot-as-his-page; the annex-verification word.
